visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with long brown hair, wearing a white t-shirt and a white watch, sits behind a wooden desk with five stacks of blue and pink 'Chiikawa' branded boxes. She smiles and looks at the camera excitedly. (2) She picks up a pink box, showing the front to the camera, then rips it open at the top. (3) She presents a white plastic cup with a 3D embossed Chiikawa character wearing a McDonald's hat. She rotates the cup with her hands. (4) The woman opens a second pink box. She reveals a rabbit character toy sitting on a pancake base, which also opens to reveal stickers inside. (5) She opens a third pink box, showing a small red McDonald's car toy. She peels stickers from a sheet and applies them to the car's windows. (6) A blue cat character toy is shown on a small frame; the character moves slightly when a wheel is turned. (7) She opens a blue box from a second set, revealing a white character-shaped container with notepad sheets inside. (8) She opens another blue box, revealing a white character holding a large red McDonald's fry container. (9) She shows a green plastic photo frame with a cat character on the corner; she inserts and removes a cartoon card from the frame. (10) She opens the final blue box, showing a rabbit character on a red box that dispenses a strip of paper tape. (11) The woman gathers all the toys on the desk, looking happy but slightly overwhelmed, ending with a grayscale filter.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) High-pitched, energetic female speech begins over an upbeat acoustic guitar and drum rhythm. Sound of soft plastic crinkling is audible. (2) Vocal pitch rises as she says '趕快', followed by a 'pop' sound effect as a box is visually opened. (3) Mechanical rotation sound and a soft 'ding' occur when the character cup is shown. (4) Frequent paper rustling sounds as more items are removed from packaging. (5) A 'whoosh' transition sound occurs between unboxing segments. (6) Sudden volume swell in the speaker's voice expressing excitement, with 'cartoon-style' digital SFX accentuating toy movements. (7) Final segment features a lower, slightly comedic vocal tone accompanied by the same upbeat BGM track continuing to the end.
